fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. v0.36.2 keeps the v0.36.1 mirror-only OCum model and free-scene alignment fix unchanged, and restores build compatibility after the legacy native SKEEOverlayRefresh implementation was removed: the remaining PapyrusAnimationBridge reference now resolves to a no-op compatibility shim, so no deprecated RaceMenu rebuild path is reintroduced.
